baseline_models.mechanism: Covering or denying truth identifies the recipients; 'their day' is a severe event specifically theirs, and the passive threat fixes that event to an appointment.

activation_trace.role: Blocking or denying truth supplies the act that classifies the recipients.
A descending severe event makes the day the calamity itself, not only a calendar unit.
Threat-specific warning gives the passive promise its adverse force.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the event's fixed appointment.

changed_reading.before: A general curse on unbelievers because of a future day.
changed_reading.after: Woe issues from a specifically owned event-day arriving at the fixed appointment of a threat against those who cover truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material sense of كَفَرُوا (word 3) against the arrival of يَوْمِهِم (word 5)
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of covering permits a reader-supplied reversal: those who cover enter a severe event that strips concealment of efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the defensive action that the event will render ineffective.
The severe event supplies the pressure under which the cover fails.
The fixed appointment prevents concealment from indefinitely postponing exposure.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is only the name of a condemned belief.
changed_reading.after: The line also stages a reversal in which the practice of covering meets an appointed event that can no longer be covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ (words 5 and 7), including the secondary mapped inventory under و ع د
baseline_models.mechanism: The secondary ع د د mapping combines counting, preparation, and recurrent fixed time, making the promised day a measured term already being readied rather than an unspecified future.

activation_trace.role: A duration of time supplies the interval through which the term is measured.
Counting and gathering numbers makes the term determinate.
Preparing stores or equipment makes the coming event already provisioned for execution.
A fixed time that returns at known intervals contributes schedule rather than vagueness.

changed_reading.before: They are merely told that a day will come.
changed_reading.after: Their term is already counted, prepared, and held to a determinate schedule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered cases turn the focus threat into a process: dispatch, turning away, bounded respite, taking to account, and inability to rise.

activation_trace.role: The focus threat is the endpoint whose internal sequence the context activates.
Sending and setting in motion begins the warning process.
Turning away supplies the refusal that interrupts reception of the warning.
Assigning a known time makes enjoyment a bounded respite rather than cancellation.
Taking to account for an offense supplies execution after respite.
Bodily rising supplies the capacity explicitly lost at the sequence's endpoint.

structural_cues: 51:38-45 orders message, refusal, respite, seizure, and failed recovery.
51:40-46 repeats completed communal precedents before the focus future.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered stages; I infer that they disclose the internal trajectory of 'their day.' Alternatively, the cases may only certify that the threat is reliable.

changed_reading.before: The promised day is an isolated future calamity.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal phase of a repeatedly demonstrated warning-to-collapse sequence already visible in prior peoples.

context_deltas.mechanism: Built and widened heaven, prepared earth, paired creation, and elicited remembrance place the promised event inside an articulated order; the day is a terminal reordering, not an alien interruption.

activation_trace.role: The focus day remains the severe event whose relation to created order is revised.
Joining parts into a construction supplies an ordered cosmic frame.
Expansion against constriction makes that frame dynamic rather than closed.
Preparing and leveling an affair makes earth a deliberately readied field.
Joining each counterpart to its mate contributes differentiation within order.
A reminder that makes one remember states the cognitive purpose of the ordered signs.

structural_cues: 51:47-49 moves from heaven to earth to paired things before the imperatives of 51:50.
The focus warning follows a constructed order that was presented as material for remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, expansion, preparation, pairing, and reminder; I infer that the promised day operates within that same ordering power. Alternatively, these details may only prove power to deliver an otherwise external punishment.

changed_reading.before: The day breaks into creation from outside its ordinary order.
changed_reading.after: The day is an appointed reconfiguration by the same agency that builds, expands, prepares, and differentiates creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight toward God and a warning that awakens caution and clarifies meaning make the promised day a deadline preceded by an actionable route, not a fatalistic notification.

activation_trace.role: Denial now includes refusing a disclosed route rather than lacking notice.
The adverse threat supplies the deadline before which response remains meaningful.
Literal flight supplies urgent directed motion away from danger.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution makes advance notice operational.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes the route intelligible.

structural_cues: 51:50 directs flight to God and 51:51 excludes a second deity.
The clear-warning formula is repeated in both verses immediately before the inherited-rejection sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flight, caution-awakening warning, and clarification; I infer that warning opens a present route before the appointment. Alternatively, it may only intensify culpability without implying escape.

changed_reading.before: The line announces an unavoidable fate to a fixed class.
changed_reading.after: It closes a warning interval in which a clear route of flight was offered, so continued covering becomes refusal of disclosed direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring 'magician or madman' formula supplies a linguistic technology of kufr: circulating labels divert the message and cover reason, while reminder works in the opposite direction by restoring what was obscured.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the function assigned to the repeated labels.
A saying spread among people supplies the social reproducibility of the formula.
Diversion and deception supply one label's power to redirect attention from the message.
Covering the intellect by madness supplies the other label's dismissal of the messenger.
Mutually transmitting counsel makes inherited coordination a live question.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the packet's alternative to literal coordination.
The reminder supplies the counter-operation that reactivates what covering suppresses.

structural_cues: 51:39 first voices the same two labels that 51:52 generalizes across earlier recipients.
51:53 asks about transmission, rejects it in favor of transgression, and 51:55 nevertheless commands reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated labels, the counsel question, transgression, and reminder; I infer that the labels function as cover over warning. Alternatively, repetition may mark only continuity of rejection, not a stable social technique.

changed_reading.before: Those who disbelieve are an abstract doctrinal class.
changed_reading.after: They are also participants in a repeatable speech practice that covers warning with inherited dismissive labels even as reminder keeps reopening it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creaturely worship is framed by a giver who asks no provision or feeding and whose strength is already gathered; kufr therefore activates as covering gift and refusing asymmetrical dependence, not depriving God of supply.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefit or leaving it unthanked supplies the relational failure named in the focus.
Submissive worship supplies the intended creaturely orientation.
A divided gift is explicitly not demanded from creatures, removing extraction from the relation.
Feeding another is negated as a divine need and sharpens the nonextractive asymmetry.
The same divided-gift branch returns with God as the intensive giver.
Strength gathered like cord strands excludes punishment as compensation for weakness.

structural_cues: 51:56 states creaturely purpose; 51:57 twice negates divine demand; 51:58 identifies the giver and strength.
The focus woe follows this asymmetry rather than a claim that God needs creaturely service.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, negated demand, unilateral provision, and strength; I infer that the warning answers covered gift and resisted dependence. Alternatively, the sequence may foreground command alone rather than gratitude.

changed_reading.before: Woe punishes failure to supply divine service.
changed_reading.after: Woe answers the covering of unilateral gift and refusal of creaturely orientation toward a giver who needs no return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, wrongdoing outside proper place or time receives a share matching prior companions and is told not to accelerate; 'their day' becomes the correctly timed delivery of that proportioned share.

activation_trace.role: The severe event supplies the form in which the allotted consequence arrives.
The bounded appointment supplies the proper time for delivery.
Putting something outside its proper place or time defines the disorder answered by correct timing.
A portion or allotted share makes the consequence distributive rather than undifferentiated.
Likeness to a counterpart calibrates the share against prior recipients.
Accompaniment links the present recipients to the earlier cohorts whose pattern they share.
Acceleration and premature advancement, here negated, preserve the appointment's delay.

structural_cues: 51:59 and 51:60 form one consequence statement joined by فويل.
The possessive 'their' follows a matching share for people linked to prior companions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies portion, likeness, companionship, and negated haste; I infer that the portion is temporally cashed out as 'their day.' Alternatively, the day may only be the deadline for receiving a separately defined share.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens a generic future day.
changed_reading.after: Each rejecting cohort has a matched share continuous with its predecessors, and its own appointed day delivers that share without being hurried.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a secondary water branch under the focus root و ع د to the immediate full-bucket and waterwheel branches in 51:59. It remains anchored in يُوعَدُونَ and the adjacent ذَنوب/no-haste construction, but downstream prose should present it only as a packet-induced material analogy, never as a lexical replacement for 'promised day.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُوعَدُونَ (51:60 word 7) read beside the two occurrences of ذَنوب and the no-haste clause in 51:59

activation_trace.role: An enduring well or gathered water supplies a persistent reservoir from which a due measure can be drawn.
A full bucket supplies the concrete measured draw assigned to each cohort.
A waterwheel for drawing and carrying supplies a paced delivery mechanism, while the verse negates haste.

changed_reading.before: A date simply waits for them in the future.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their appointment is their turn to draw a full measure from an enduring reservoir of consequence, whose delivery cannot be accelerated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates agricultural side-images entirely within the focus inventories. Covering seed, temporal duration, and a sign promising a coming condition remain anchored in the three focus roots, but no harvest word occurs; downstream prose should qualify it as a consequence-growth metaphor rather than a translation.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with earth supplies a hidden initiating act whose effects can later emerge.
A duration of time supplies the interval in which the covered act matures.
A promising sign from land or day supplies expectation of the condition that eventually appears.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is a static state followed by an unrelated punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, covering is a planted act that matures through its own duration into the adverse day it has come to promise.

strongest_changes: The immediate 51:59 portion, likeness, companionship, and no-haste sequence recasts 'their day' as a matched and delayed allotment continuous with earlier cohorts.
The warning-to-collapse precedents turn the day from an isolated catastrophe into the endpoint of a repeated process.
The flight and clear-warning pair makes the appointment a deadline preceded by an actionable route.
The repeated magician/madman formula gives kufr a concrete speech mechanism: inherited labels cover warning while reminder reopens it.
The worship and provision sequence removes divine need and shifts kufr toward covering unilateral gift.
summary.what_was_special: The possessive day became both process and apportioned share. The packet's split mapping under و ع د also preserved a deliberately contained full-bucket/from-an-enduring-well image that a conservative reading would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise force of مِن before 'their day' may be causal, partitive, or source-like, and the models do not force one syntax.
The cosmic construction sequence may define the event's mechanism or may only certify power to deliver it.
The secondary-root water and agricultural activations are analogical discoveries, not lexical disambiguations.
